<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Recipe>
  <Description title="Mo/SiO2 5-bilayer stack on glass, D=60.0A" type="Sputtering" author="LAB" notes="Audit fixture for Sputter batch coater."/>
  <Parameters>
    <Group name="Deposition Conditions">
      <Param name="P" caption="Working pressure" unit="mTorr" paramType="0">3.00mT</Param>
      <Param name="ArFlow" caption="Ar flow" unit="sccm" paramType="1">30</Param>
      <Param name="N" caption="Bilayers" unit="N" paramType="1">5</Param>
    </Group>
    <Group name="Mo Layer">
      <Param name="currentMo" caption="Mo current" unit="mA" paramType="1">200</Param>
      <Param name="freqMo" caption="Mo frequency" unit="kHz" paramType="1">50</Param>
      <Param name="dutyMo" caption="Mo duty" unit="%" paramType="1">60</Param>
      <Param name="timeMo" caption="Mo time" unit="sec" paramType="1">25.00</Param>
    </Group>
    <Group name="SiO2 Layer">
      <Param name="powerSiO2" caption="SiO2 power" unit="W" paramType="1">150</Param>
      <Param name="timeSiO2" caption="SiO2 time" unit="sec" paramType="1">100.00</Param>
    </Group>
  </Parameters>
  <Script>
# --- substrate rotation ---
rotate 15

# --- admit argon and wait for pressure ---
valve V1 open
valve M1 open
valve M2 open
mfc Ar1 ArFlow
pwait P 300

# --- configure supplies ---
set PSU1 Frequency freqMo
set PSU1 DutyCycle dutyMo
set PSU1 Current currentMo
set PSU2 Current powerSiO2
warmup PSU1 100 30
power PSU2 on
message Confirm both plasmas are stable before starting multilayer

# --- 5 bilayers: Mo 20.0 A then SiO2 40.0 A ---
loop N
deposit Mo timeMo Home
deposit SiO2 timeSiO2
endloop

# old cap step; power PSU2 on

# --- teardown ---
power PSU1 off
power PSU2 off
mfc Ar1 0
valve M1 close
valve M2 close
valve V1 close
  </Script>
</Recipe>

findings.message: 'pwait' takes 3 argument(s) on this machine (sensor target timeout) — the sensor selects which chamber's throttle valve to drive
'set PSU2 Current': unknown parameter 'Current' for PSU2 — the driver would refuse it at run time. Valid (exact spelling): Power
'warmup' argument 1 must be a time value (number with optional s, m or h suffix), got 'PSU1'
'deposit' takes 2 argument(s), got 3 — 'Home' is not used by this command and would be silently discarded
substrate rotation ('rotate') is not operational on this machine
'message' opens a blocking operator dialog on the Control UI that halts unattended execution and survives abort_recipe
deposit 'Mo' runs while its power supply 'PSU1' is not energized ('warmup' does not leave power on; add 'power PSU1 on' before depositing)

scriptSummary.pwaitTimeoutsNote: pwait/swait timeout arguments (e.g. 600 s, 10 s) are upper-bound ceilings, not fixed durations; total wall-clock run time cannot be determined without running the recipe.
scriptSummary.commentsNote: All text after '#' or '//' on a line (including ';' characters) is stripped before statement splitting and is completely inert.
